options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Determine the goal for the seed

Minikits: Collect Minikits to win.
Levels Beaten: Beat Levels to win.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer le but de la semence

Minikits: Recueillir des minikits pour gagner.
Levels Beaten: Battre les niveaux pour gagner.

options.name: Minikit Sanity
options.doc: Puts all 300 Minikits into the pool.

options.name: Total Minikits
options.doc: Number of Minikits needed to win. Only applicable if win con is set to Minikits Collected.

options.name: Total Levels
options.doc: Number of Levels Beaten needed to win. Only applicable if win con is set to Levels Beaten.

options.name: True Status Sanity
options.doc: Shuffles the true status of each level.

options.name: Unlock Story or Story and Freeplay
options.doc:
Determines if the level unlocked item gives you Story Mode or Story Mode & Freeplay.
If turned off, Freeplay is unlocked by completing Story Mode.
